text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here, Trainer! The Champions Cup.
The grand finale of our Classic Year!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's finally time for the showdown!

text_block_list.text: "All dirt GⅠ races around this time are held with mixed fields of Classic and Senior competitors."
"Among them, the 'Champions Cup' is one of the few JRA dirt GⅠ races. It's an event where elite powerhouses like Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute gather."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Looking back, so much has happened between our debut and now, hasn't it? ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The giant Bazhai chart we mapped out together. There were
plenty of fluctuations and unexpected twists. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I came all this way to make someone chasing a dream,
or someone troubled, happy through Feng Shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, getting ahead of myself and falling behind before summer
is still having a bit of an impact, though.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If only I had trained
more during that time, you know?
choice_data_list: That's a learning experience too, Rickey.

text_block_list.text:
"Even if it takes a bit of a detour,
some things you just won't realize until you try."

"Then it cannot be called a mistake. It is precisely
because you know the wrong path that you can move straight forward."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you're right☆
Just like Trainer said!
No hanging my head, no looking back, only looking forward!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's go compete with
Tarumae and Acute-san♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, Acute-san, let's have a great race today!
I might not have as much experience yet, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I've still got Feng Shui on my side!
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ A grand comeback turnaround!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: "I can't let that happen. I've devoted myself to running for so long. All for my beloved Tomakomai. So..."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose to Rickey after all her detours.
And on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching today.
To see whether that Rickey can truly hold her own in the Senior Class.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, you two.
You've gotta get along, or it won't do~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: If you're gonna fight, how 'bout I win and smooth things over nice and easy~?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, not on my watch!
I'm not giving up the win that easily!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Hmm, they're both so used to the big stage.
They look completely relaxed out there. But—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: My luck is on the rise! Having steadily prepared the ground up to now, I can make things work if the flow is right!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, moving forward alongside the Azure Dragon!
I'll prove that the power of Feng Shui reaches these two as well!
